known_issue: Draw recall is 30.3%, which is substantially below home_win (67.2%). This is a known challenge in football prediction — draws are inherently difficult to predict because they often result from evenly matched teams or defensive play patterns not captured by aggregate statistics.
fairness_notes: The Kaggle international football results dataset does not include demographic attributes. Bias analysis is limited to football-specific groupings: outcome class, tournament type, and venue. No claims are made about demographic fairness.
